decisions.decision: Wh/km numerator is the HYBRID measured-kWh minus capacity-SoC-correction, not the proposal's original capacity x dSoC
decisions.why: car_type is model-coarse (no trim), so capacity carries a ~25% error band; the hybrid confines that error to a small correction term instead of the whole numerator

decisions.decision: Unknown pack capacity drops the SoC correction and sets Approximate=true; it is NOT an ok=false case
decisions.why: account.Vehicle.CarType is NULL for every vehicle not re-polled since RM6, so the unknown case is common at first and must not blank the dashboard tile

decisions.decision: SoC endpoints use a consistent field family - usable only when BOTH endpoints have it, else nominal for both
decisions.why: a per-endpoint fallback can mix usable with nominal; usable runs 1-3 points lower, manufacturing a phantom dSoC worth ~1.5 kWh of fake energy at 75 kWh

decisions.decision: D3/D4/D5 taken without further interview: 30d constructor const window; RecentEfficiency carries accountID; WhPerKm returned raw
decisions.why: user switched on autopilot mid-interview; all three had clear recommendations and accountID is forced by the account-scoped telemetry/manualcharge ports

decisions.decision: Accepted the artifact worker's self-made D6 (bounded limit 200 + Go-side date filter) instead of re-dispatching
decisions.why: verified both charging ports are newest-first (manualcharge ORDER BY charged_on DESC, supercharger charge_start_date_time DESC), so 200 rows covers any 30-day window
